citation: Bleses, D., Dale, P. S., Justice, L., Højen, A., Vind, B. D., & Jiang, H. (2021). Sustained effects of an early childhood language and literacy intervention through second grade: Longitudinal findings of the SPELL trial in Denmark. PLoS ONE, 16(10), e0258287. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0258287
report_number: PLoS ONE 16(10): e0258287 (no IES/EEF number; gold open-access journal article; SPELL RCT long-term follow-up)
design: Cluster-RCT; random assignment at the childcare-CENTER level to one of four conditions (BAU vs three SPELL language/preliteracy curriculum supplements: SPELL, SPELL+PD, SPELL+HOME). Original SPELL trial: 144 centers (BAU n=36, SPELL n=38, SPELL+PD n=34, SPELL+HOME n=34), 561 teachers, 7,076 children 3-6 yrs in Denmark; 20-week storybook-based intervention delivered by preschool teachers. Subject = early language/literacy (pre-K delivery); this 2021 paper reports the LONG-TERM follow-up: the Danish mandatory national reading test in 2nd grade (standardized, IRT/computer-adaptive, independent) for 2,700 of the 4-5-yr-old participants (BAU 701, SPELL 770, SPELL+PD 692, SPELL+HOME 537), administered 3-6 years after the preschool intervention.
problems: ARM-MAPPING AMBIGUITY: registry row 7 ('Bleses et al. 2021', is_multi_arm=0, tpd_goal='TPD for curricula', duration='Short', trainer='External', coaching=0) maps to a SINGLE arm, but the trial has THREE TPD-vs-BAU arms (SPELL, SPELL+PD, SPELL+HOME). The base SPELL arm best matches the registry coding: SPELL = curriculum supplement with short, external teacher training and NO ongoing coaching ('TPD for curricula', 'Short', coaching=0). SPELL+PD adds EXTENDED professional development/coaching for teachers (would not be 'Short'/coaching=0), and SPELL+HOME adds a parent home program (not teacher PD). So the meta-analysis's single coded effect almost certainly corresponds to the base SPELL arm. To preserve full traceability all three arms are extracted under row_id 7, each clearly labeled; the central team should retain SPELL (and may also use SPELL+PD as a second TPD arm) and likely drop SPELL+HOME as not-teacher-PD. WHY THE 2021 PAPER (not the 2018 Child Development paper): the meta-analysis's literature search was limited to reports published 2020-2021 (Supplement Section 2), and this PLoS ONE 2021 follow-up is the SPELL report within that window; its outcome is the 2nd-grade national reading test. TIMEPOINT: per the spec the immediate end-of-treatment wave is the PRESCHOOL post-test (Table 3, p.12), but those four subtests (deletion, letter identification, vocabulary, comprehension) are teacher-administered RESEARCHER-MADE measures reported only as raw means/SDs (no model-based impact estimate or SE, and pretest scores were imbalanced between groups). This 2021 paper's analytic, pretest-adjusted, model-based impact estimates with SEs exist ONLY for the standardized INDEPENDENT 2nd-grade reading test (Table 4, p.13), which is also the only measure type the meta-analysis included (independent measures). Therefore the extracted effect_sizes use Table 4 (2nd-grade reading); the preschool post-test means/SDs are recorded in notes for completeness (computed unadjusted, not cluster-corrected: e.g. SPELL g_deletion=+0.17, g_lettering=+0.12, g_vocab=-0.12, g_comp=-0.03; SPELL+PD g_deletion=+0.22, g_lettering=+0.15, g_vocab=-0.03, g_comp=+0.08; SPELL+HOME g_deletion=+0.03, g_lettering=+0.06, g_vocab=-0.20, g_comp=-0.08). STANDARDIZATION: all three 2nd-grade reading outcomes were standardized to mean 0, SD 1 (Methods p.9-10; Table 3 SDs ~0.9-1.1 confirm), so the Table 4 coefficient IS d (impact in SD units) and the reported SE is se(d). CLUSTER: impact estimates come from cross-classified mixed-effects models with random effects for childcare classroom + 2nd-grade classroom + their crossing, plus child-level covariates and pretests -> cluster_adjusted=true, pretest_adjusted=true. n_clusters per arm is the number of childcare CENTERS as randomized (BAU 36 + SPELL 38 / SPELL+PD 34 / SPELL+HOME 34); ICC recorded = childcare-classroom ICC (the design ICC at the randomization-relevant clustering level: .14 language comprehension, .16 decoding, .14 reading comprehension; second-grade-classroom and crossing ICCs and child-level ICC also reported in Methods p.9). n_t/n_c are analytic children in the 2nd-grade follow-up sample (Table 2/Table 3). All three 2nd-grade reading effects are non-significant for every arm (Table 4); the report's headline finding is null for the whole sample with effects only in moderation/subgroup analyses (low-mid maternal education), which are NOT extracted here (subgroup, non-randomised). No outcome here is designated the single 'primary' confirmatory outcome; the three reading scores are treated as co-equal -> labeled secondary (none is a composite/total).

effect_sizes.arm_label: SPELL (base): 20-week storybook language/preliteracy curriculum supplement delivered by preschool teachers after short external training (no ongoing coaching) vs business-as-usual. BEST MATCH to registry coding 'TPD for curricula', 'Short', coaching=0.
effect_sizes.grade_band: Pre-K delivery (children 4-5 yrs); outcome measured in Grade 2 (3-6 yrs later)
effect_sizes.test_name: Danish national reading test (Grade 2) - Language comprehension subscale
effect_sizes.timepoint: Grade 2 follow-up (spring 2016-2019; 3-6 yrs post-intervention). NOTE: this is a long-term follow-up, not the end-of-treatment preschool wave (see problems).
effect_sizes.g_method: Outcome standardized to SD=1; Table 4 coefficient = d = -0.07, se(d)=0.062 from a pretest- and covariate-adjusted cross-classified mixed-effects model. df=n_t+n_c-2=1469, J=1-3/(4*df-1)=0.99949, g=J*d=-0.06996, g_se=J*se(d)=0.06197, g_var=g_se^2=0.003840.
effect_sizes.page_ref: Table 4 (p.13); model/ICC in Methods (pp.9-10); Ns in Table 2/Table 3 (pp.11-12)
effect_sizes.notes: Non-significant (p=0.283). n_clusters=74 = 38 SPELL + 36 BAU childcare centers (as randomized). icc=0.14 is the childcare-classroom ICC for language comprehension (also reported: 2nd-grade-classroom ICC 0.18, crossing 0.07, child-level 0.57-0.62). Preschool post-test (researcher-made) for this arm: language comprehension subtest g=-0.03 (means 20.3 vs 20.4).
